description: Because we strive to put people first. Culture, our way. About The Role We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Planning & Trading Technology team, supporting the delivery of smart retail ordering solutions across Forecasting, Allocation and Replenishment. Working closely with Product Owners, Technology teams and business stakeholders, you will help shape requirements, improve processes and deliver innovative solutions that optimise stock management and forecasting capabilities. This is an excellent opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives that drive business performance and enhance the customer experience within a fast-paced retail environment. What You'll Do Partner with business stakeholders across Planning, Supply Chain, Technology and Trading teams to elicit, analyse and document detailed business requirements, ensuring all objectives, challenges and opportunities are clearly understood and translated into actionable deliverables. Own the creation and maintenance of user stories, epics, acceptance criteria and process documentation, working closely with Product Owners to ensure the product backlog is prioritised and aligned to business goals. Conduct current and future state process analysis, identifying gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement across forecasting, allocation and replenishment processes to help drive operational excellence. Collaborate with architects, developers, QA teams and other technology partners throughout the delivery lifecycle, ensuring solutions are designed and implemented in line with business requirements and strategic objectives. Facilitate workshops, stakeholder meetings and discovery sessions to build consensus, manage expectations and drive effective decision-making across both technical and non-technical audiences. Support end-to-end testing activities, including test scenario creation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution and validation of delivered functionality to ensure successful implementation and user satisfaction. Act as a key liaison between the business and technology teams, driving change management, user adoption and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value. What You'll Bring Proven experience working as a Business Analyst within a retail, supply chain, merchandising or technology environment, with a strong track record of successfully delivering business and technology transformation initiatives. Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies, including experience working within Scrum or Kanban frameworks and collaborating closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters and development teams. Demonstrated ability to gather, document and manage complex business requirements, translating business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria. Experience analysing and improving business processes, with the ability to identify root causes, recommend solutions and drive process optimisation across multiple stakeholder groups. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, challenge and engage effectively with colleagues at all organisational levels, including senior leadership. Hands-on experience using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence or similar platforms for backlog management, documentation, requirements tracking and delivery governance. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, combined with a structured approach to decision-making and a passion for delivering innovative technology solutions that improve business outcomes. What You’ll Get People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre, and a subsidised cafeteria. Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours. About Primark At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 18 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together. description: About The Company Jeeny is a leading ride-hailing platform that strives to revolutionize daily commuting and transportation. Our app connects users with their preferred modes of transportation, making mobility accessible, convenient, and affordable for all. We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Since our inception, we have grown exponentially and currently operate in Saudi Arabia and Jordan with making an impact in the lives of more than 45 million people. At Jeeny, we value innovation, teamwork, and passion for delivering exceptional user experiences. Join us in our mission to transform the mobility landscape. About the role: As the Growth Manager - Insights & Analytics, you will play a pivotal role within the commercial team: the strategic engine powering our marketplace expansion. You'll translate complex data into actionable insights that drive high-impact growth initiatives and inform strategic decisions. Partnering closely with Marketing, Product, and Operations, you'll lead CRM and DRM strategies while managing growth spends to maximize ROI. You'll also oversee budget allocation to ensure every marketing dollar and incentive delivers measurable sustainable growth and long-term profitability. Responsibilities: CRM/DRM Strategy & Lifecycle Management Lifecycle Campaign Development: Design and execute lifecycle campaigns for both passengers and partners - spanning onboarding, activation, reactivation, retention, and overall engagement across multi-channel touchpoints (in-app, push, email, SMS) Segmentation & Personalization: Build dynamic segmentation models leveraging RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) and behavioral data to tailor messaging, incentives, and experiences that maximize engagement and loyalty across both sides of the marketplace Performance Analysis: Continuously monitor CRM/DRM performance metrics, translate insights into actionable improvements, and optimize campaign ROI through data-backed iteration Continuous experimentation: (A/B, multivariate, incentive, and journey tests) to uncover high-impact growth levers across the user and partner lifecycle Touch True Marketplace Levers: Monitor and analyze key marketplace metrics, identifying friction points and opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, reactivation and retention. Advanced Analytics: Leverage advanced analytics and funnel modeling to enhance conversion efficiency across the entire user/partner journey Incrementality Testing: Apply incrementality and cohort analyses to measure true impact of growth initiatives and guide resource allocation Data to Strategy: Synthesize insights into clear, actionable strategies that inform leadership decisions and drive sustainable marketplace growth Playbook Creation: Build scalable growth playbooks that codify both wins and misses - turning 5/5 successes into repeatable frameworks and 0/5 failures into data-backed lessons that sharpen Jeeny's experimentation muscle Competitive Intelligence & Growth Strategy Market Pulse: Continuously analyze competitor growth initiatives — such as engagement mechanics, incentive structures, and marketplace strategies to uncover opportunities to strengthen user and partner retention Translate competitive insights into actionable growth plays, influencing lifecycle strategies, incentive design, and experimentation priorities Use trend analysis and data modeling to forecast competitive movements and guide long-term growth investments and priorities Forecasting Models & Predictive Analytics Build intelligent forecasting models to predict marketplace trends: from active users and engaged partners to trip demand, retention rates, and incentive efficiency - enabling smarter, faster growth decisions Turn predictions into strategy: empowering teams to act proactively, drive sustainable growth, and keep the marketplace ahead of shifting behaviors and competitive dynamics Automation & Scalability Design and implement automated workflows to streamline reporting, campaign execution, and performance tracking across CRM and DRM initiatives Collaborate with Product and Data teams to build scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and decision-support tools that enable real-time visibility into growth metrics Automate experimentation and lifecycle triggers, ensuring consistent, timely, and personalized user and partner engagement Standardize analytics and growth frameworks across markets, reducing manual dependency and improving operational efficiency Budget Management: Own the growth budgeting cycle, ensuring optimal allocation of incentives, marketing, and CRM/DRM spend Track performance against budgets, highlighting ROI, efficiency gains, and areas for reallocation Develop data-driven strategies that maximize financial impact while mitigating operational and growth risks People Management: Lead a team of high-performing individuals, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement Define and track OKRs, aligning team objectives with strategic growth priorities Enable high performance through coaching, feedback loops, and clear accountability Foster innovation and collaboration by empowering talent and promoting continuous learning Requirements Bachelor's or Master's in Business, Analytics, Economics, or a quantitative discipline At least 5 years experience in an analytical role dealing with large volumes of data, Experience in pricing/discount strategy and/or on-demand is a plus preferably in mobility, e-commerce, or marketplace sectors Solid grasp of statistics and demonstrated experience with A/B testing Amazing SQL and Excel skills. Experience with Python or R is a plus Experience with some BI tools and data visualization like Tableau, Power BI or Looker Experience with CRM tools (Braze, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clevertap) and/or marketing automation platforms Excellent communication skills; able to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders Benefits Why Join Us You'll lead a team that sits at the heart of the company's growth engine - where data meets creativity, and strategy meets execution. At Jeeny, you'll have the freedom to innovate, experiment, and build systems that directly shape how millions of users and partners interact with our application every day. This is more than analytics - it's impact at scale.

Data accuracy and integrity. Cross-functional support and stakeholder satisfaction.

We build powerful analytics in the US and Indian stock market space that are best in class. Organic growth in B2B and B2C products have already made the company profitable. We deliver 1 billion+ APIs every month to B2B customers, and have a B2C website and app. Our founders are IIT + IIM graduates, with strong tech and marketing experience. We have top finance and management experts on the Board of Directors. If you love analytics and great products that are often first to market, this will be your playground. Non-negotiables Minimum of 3 years of work experience in growth marketing. Bachelor's degree or above. Management post-graduates are preferred. Experience with various marketing channels, including Google Ads, LinkedIn, and email marketing platforms. Experience in wealth management, investing, broking, or any stock market-related business. Work specifically in trading platforms is a plus. Fluency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) Excellent 5/5 written, verbal, and communication skills; ability to work well with teams and multiple stakeholders

description: Job Description Just imagine expanding LEGO® Insiders across LEGO Certified Stores, LEGOLAND Parks, and future partner-operated channels. Then make it real. About The Role As our Manager, Membership Expansion (Branded Channels), you'll play a pivotal role in growing LEGO® Insiders across branded and other partner-operated channels. By identifying, developing, and recommending new opportunities, you'll drive membership acquisition, participation, and commercial performance while delivering value for both members and partners. The role spans channels including LEGO Certified Stores, LEGOLAND Parks, and future expansion opportunities. Working across markets and stakeholder groups, you'll help shape how the membership programme grows and evolves. It's a chance to contribute to a strategically important growth agenda for the LEGO Group while creating meaningful experiences for members around the world. Please note This role is based in our London HUB and will not offer relocation. Required Qualifications Delivered loyalty, membership, CRM, customer growth, retail marketing, or related commercial initiatives with measurable business impact. Managed programmes involving multiple partners, markets, or stakeholder groups. Maximised business performance through return-on-investment analysis and commercial evaluation. Built customer acquisition, loyalty, or membership initiatives from concept through execution. Developed commercial proposals and assessed business opportunities to support growth objectives. Led cross-functional initiatives and influenced stakeholders within a matrix organisation. Preferred Qualifications Applied CRM and loyalty economics to improve customer growth or retention outcomes. Created business recommendations through storytelling with data. Negotiated commercial opportunities with partners or stakeholders. Demonstrated commercial acumen when assessing growth opportunities. What You'll Build Expand LEGO Insiders coverage across LEGO Certified Stores. Optimise membership activation across LEGOLAND Parks. Support the transition of LEGO Discovery Centres into the wider membership ecosystem. Identify and shape future opportunities for membership expansion across partner-operated channels. Help create a coordinated approach to membership growth across a range of markets and channel environments. If you've worked in a role where you delivered membership or loyalty initiatives, evaluated commercial opportunities, and partnered with external organisations, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to connect commercial insight with practical action and bring stakeholders together around shared goals. Life on the team You'll join the Membership Growth & Expansion team within Central Marketing. We elevate and scale LEGO Insiders through growth strategies, a differentiated membership proposition, and audience-led approaches that strengthen long-term member value. We work in a hybrid rhythm and collaborate closely across global and local teams. You'll be part of a team that values a growth mindset, applies critical thinking to complex challenges, takes accountability for outcomes, and learns from different perspectives. What Success Looks Like Success means expanding membership growth across a variety of partners, markets, and experiences while balancing the needs of members and commercial partners. Over the next 12 to 18 months, the team will continue building the foundations for long-term member growth and loyalty at scale. You'll work closely with colleagues across Membership and Personalization, regional and market teams, and Global Commercial Development to help shape the future of membership expansion. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What’s in it for you? Here is what you can expect Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times. Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind. Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity. Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount. Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme. Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process. Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong. The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team. The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer. Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights. Just imagine building your dream career. Then make it real. Join the LEGO® team today.
